name: Slide Puzzle
author: Przemysław Bądaruk (Przemekkkth), after Al Sweigart
description: The fifteen puzzle: put the numbered tiles back in order. Tap a tile next to the gap to slide it, or swipe. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: The fifteen puzzle: put the numbered tiles back in order. Tap a tile next to the gap to slide it, or swipe. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Il gioco del quindici: rimetti in ordine le tessere numerate. Tocca una tessera vicina al buco per farla scorrere, oppure scorri. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
